summary.he: בלשכה בלי לוח התראות משלה: כל התראה של הלשכה נמסרת ללוח של העדר דרך הקישור, ונשמרת עד שהלוח עונה
summary.en: On an office with no notice board of its own: every notice is carried to the herd's board over the link, and kept until it answers

use.reason: the office's own board (the provider of notify) and this relay both answer the name `notifications`: never both enabled (the compiler refuses the plan, naming both)

data.note: The notices kept, in order, while the hub's board does not answer (spool.jsonl, capped: the oldest go first, said in the log).
